research_question: Does the same model produce better final economic results when one general manager performs all functions in one persistent session or when the same functions are separated into persistent Critic, Planner, Consciousness and Actor roles?

arms.control: one general manager; four structured functions in one response
arms.theatre: four persistent specialized roles in critic-planner-consciousness-actor order

primary_metric: final liquid cash minus the identical virtual output-token charge
analysis: report mean and median Theatre-minus-control paired difference
report seed wins and reliability outcomes
bootstrap the paired difference after all five pairs
treat an interval including zero as inconclusive
stopping_rules: provider quota pauses preserve the exact durable phase
contract failure stops loudly and remains in evidence
no failed, paused, bankrupt or low-scoring run is discarded
activation_gate: No model call is allowed until this preregistration and every frozen artifact are published in one clean source commit and that exact commit is recorded in the pair activation receipt.
